subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Are the reviewed upstream releases acceptable for OpenClaw's secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, and Codex workflows once the refreshed exact head is green?
rationale: CI can prove workflow execution but cannot decide whether maintainers accept the combined upstream executable-code and credential-boundary change across 14 actions, especially while the protected `security` label is present.

options.title: Approve after refreshed validation
options.body: Review the high-risk upstream diffs, let Dependabot rebase, and merge if all required checks pass on that exact head.

options.title: Split high-risk action updates
options.body: Separate token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and Codex action bumps when maintainers want narrower rollback and attribution boundaries.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Keep the current pins until a maintainer can complete upstream source review and exact-head validation.

recommendation.title: Approve after refreshed validation
recommendation.body: Review the high-risk upstream diffs, let Dependabot rebase, and merge if all required checks pass on that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner for repository-wide release and workflow risk based on official repository role and recent release-workflow history.
